summary: Focused testing of the NEW Offline Attendance feature (front-end + backend sync) plus a light regression. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_offline_attendance.py with 11 new tests covering POST /api/attendance/sync shape, idempotency (repeat sync stays 2 records), multi-batch, year-isolation, audit-log entry, RBAC (admin/coordinator/teacher pass, management/student 403), and edit-not-duplicate. All 11 pass. Full pytest suite is 75/75 (43 regression + 21 iteration-2 + 11 new) = 100%. Frontend Playwright (with page.context.set_offline): teacher can cache 4 class lists (clear-offline-cache shows '4 class list(s) available offline'); after set_offline+dispatch offline event: connection-status badge switches to 'Offline mode', offline-banner renders, Load Students on cached class shows '5 students — offline copy', Save button becomes 'Save on device', save queues locally (pending-sync-count=1). Marked a 2nd class (Std 6, all absent) => pending=2. Full page reload while offline preserved the queue (pending still 2) and reloading the Std 5 sheet showed the previously-marked PRESENT statuses (7/8 buttons still active — one row belongs to a different date/queue). Set_offline(False) + dispatch online event => auto-sync fired and pending cleared; Attendance History rendered 200 rows. Manual Sync produced toast 'Synced 1 class sheet(s), 5 attendance records'. Service worker registration confirmed via navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations (>=1). 5 role logins verified (admin/management/coordinator/teacher/student). Bar-chart drilldown still works. Pie-chart drilldown from iteration_2 still fails to open drilldown-dialog — remains an unfixed frontend blocker unrelated to the new offline feature.

ui_bugs.issue: Pie-slice click still does not open drilldown-dialog (regression carried over from iteration_2, NOT related to offline feature). Bar drilldowns work.

action_items: (carry-over) Fix pie-chart onClick in /app/frontend/src/components/Ui.jsx — bind onClick at the PieChart level (activePayload) or use activeShape/shape prop to guarantee sector clicks bubble in Recharts 3.6.0.
critical_code_review_comments: offline.js syncQueue clears the entire queue only on the umbrella catch — good, but if the server returns 200 with a partial per-batch failure inside `results`, the current implementation would still clear everything. Today the backend never returns per-batch failure so this is latent, but consider inspecting results[].saved before clearing individual entries.

attendance.py POST /attendance/sync currently invokes save_attendance() in a Python `for` loop (N+1 audit writes: 1 per batch + 1 sync summary). For very large offline batches this is O(batches). Consider a single bulk write with `bulk_write(UpdateOne(..., upsert=True))` if teachers commonly queue >20 classes. Not blocking.

sw.js caches only '/' and '/index.html' at install and then network-first for navigations. Static JS/CSS assets rely on runtime cache, so first-time offline visitors will still see a blank screen until they load the app at least once online. Consider precaching a build manifest.

Attendance.jsx save() distinguishes network failure by `!e.response`. Axios timeouts also satisfy this — a slow network could accidentally queue instead of retrying. Consider explicit `err.code === 'ERR_NETWORK'` check.
useOnline() uses navigator.onLine as initial state — reliable in Playwright with dispatchEvent + set_offline; note this can be stale in some browsers, so the manual sync button is a good safety net.

success_rate.frontend: Offline feature 100% (cache/load/save-queue/reload-persist/auto-sync/manual-sync/SW all pass); pie-chart drilldown regression from iteration_2 still broken

seed_data_creation: Offline tests write attendance rows on unique 2026-12-* dates in the seeded schools; no seed changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Offline attendance feature is fully verified. /app/backend/tests/test_offline_attendance.py has 11 tests covering the /api/attendance/sync endpoint (idempotency verified via history count, RBAC, year isolation, audit log, edit-not-duplicate). Front-end offline flow (cache-offline-button, offline-banner, offline-copy panel, save-on-device queuing, pending-sync-count, reload-while-offline persistence, auto-sync on online event, manual sync-attendance-button, service worker registration) all verified in Playwright with page.context.set_offline() + window.dispatchEvent('online'/'offline'). Note the online/offline React state doesn't flip in Playwright without dispatching the events explicitly since navigator.onLine is not reactive to context.setOffline alone. Pie-chart drilldown from iteration_2 still fails — unfixed but unrelated to offline.
rca of the issue: N/A — no new bugs found in the offline attendance feature. Pie-chart drilldown RCA remains as documented in iteration_2 (Recharts 3.6 doesn't forward onClick from <Pie> to sectors; needs PieChart-level onClick reading activePayload).
